why: RJ-D50, pending DX-7: Design's headless export writes SVG only until DX-7 rasterizes PNG live. Selects the 300 pt fixed-width Paragraph in the Card frame and sets it justified, line height 1.5, letter spacing 20 and italic, each one text.* step, then exports the frame as PNG: its 380 x 200 pixels have the wrapped lines' ink reaching both edges of the box (a justified line spans 40...340 within 2 px), the second baseline 1.5 x (ascent + descent) below the first, and the last line flush left. DesignTextLayoutTests checks the layout's maths on Linux.
